headline: Sensex surges 900 points, Nifty reclaims 25,800 as banking and IT stocks lead recovery

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Banking and IT stocks led a strong intraday rally driving benchmark indices higher.
Markets managed to buck early trade global sell-off pressures and recover lost ground.
Sensex gained nearly 900 points to record its second consecutive day of gains.
Nifty 50 recovered from early lows below 25,450 to close above the key 25,800 level.
whatHappening: Sensex ended up by 898 to 900 points, reaching around 25,801 by market close.
Nifty 50 reclaimed the 25,800 mark following sustained buying in mid-to-late session trading.
Indian markets opened lower in morning trade following global sell-offs in AI stocks and rate hike signals.
NSE unlisted shares jumped 3% to a fresh high as JM Financial projected potential MSCI entry in March.
summary: Indian benchmark indices staged a massive recovery on November 20, 2026, after opening lower due to global sell-offs. Sensex surged nearly 900 points to close at 25,801, while Nifty 50 reclaimed 25,800. The rally was primarily driven by strong buying interest in banking and IT stocks.
